prerequisites: Uncommitted C4R/S/T/U; earlier evidence and retained failures remain historical.
scope: Saved wind-haze art variant of C4S. Existing renderer/runtime reused through the public Bevy example. Bounded art-direction/capacity/cue qualification, not photographic approval, default adoption or stable 60 FPS.

authoring.identity: New root/dependency EffectIDs f85000/f85100..f85400; new program f85700/function f85600. Existing scoped emitter/module/material-instance/route/parameter identities and clip/cue timing/transforms/seeds retained.
authoring.unchanged: Main stars, rockets, original shell/launch haze, events, point/particle outputs, parameters, budgets, capacity and lifetimes.
authoring.births: Main stars OnDistance spacing0.8/max2, one child, zero inherited velocity; independent rate/burst0 and Point shape unchanged.

material.density_function: Seeded low-frequency three-octave noise weights0.80/0.17/0.03, UVscale1.8, age advection0.65/-0.4, anisotropic warp.
material.age_shape: Seed selects broad late wisps; extent transitions0.44 to0.31..0.48 over normalized age0.15..0.75. Soft exp(-2.4*r*r) core and edge fade0.78..1.0 replace flat-core puffs.
material.lighting: Original Scene light gain0.02, Ambient(0.055,0.06,0.07), gray albedo and Alpha/LessEqual/no depth-write retained.
material.model: Particle billboard approximation; no fluid domain or new lighting implementation.

iterations.decision: Rejected: granular breakup and26799 maximum globally dropped fragments.
iterations.config: Size1.4/2.6/4.7/6.4; acceleration0.6/0.08/0.12, drag0.32, turbulence1.2; high-frequency sparse eroded small masks.

iterations.decision: Rejected: broader quiet field but mottled puffs and36535 maximum dropped fragments.
iterations.config: Size1.6/2.4/3.5/4.4; final stronger motion; smoother broader density/masks.

iterations.decision: Narrow successful direction: lower-opacity soft cores and smaller footprint; zero sampled fragment loss. Final controls follow separately.

cost_interpretation.scope: One sequential ordinary dev-build pair, no screenshots/scans/profiling; existing bounded source/admission/playback counters remain on. Whole-host intervals include vsync/OS scheduling, not isolated GPU cost. No equivalence/speedup/fixed overhead or60FPS claim.

current.note: Reused C4U runtime binary; additions are saved art/materials and offline authoring/test code.

provenance.historical_note: Rejected drafts preserve their source files in ignored sources/ archives and their original hashes/configuration. Do not compare historical draft source hashes to final saved files.

validation.new_tests: Typed recipe equals saved assets; path births/budgets/cues/parameters/non-path emitters/choreography retained. Public compile and OIT audit at high/medium/low.
validation.clippy: cargo clippy -p aestra-bevy --all-targets --features fireworks-audio --locked --offline -- -D warnings; passed (incremental hard-link fallback notices).
validation.format: cargo fmt --all -- --check and git diff --check passed
validation.runner: PowerShell parser and native new -Effect/-HideStarSmoke arguments exercised; checker passes all six final cells and prior C4U five-cell mode.
validation.not_rerun: No renderer/workspace full test suite rerun for asset/offline-authoring slice; prior C4U renderer/host results remain separate.

remaining: Billboard puff structure, coherent volumetric depth, selected-star lighting, art approval/default adoption, ordinary whole-host tail latency, arbitrary views/hardware and production-finale density remain open.
